statement: Producer correctness checks for ordinary binary-curve third summation polynomials: six native Rust tests pass, including 24782 affine triples on 18 curves, 19664 nonzero-x hybrid triples, formal characteristic-two anchor identity, trace/sign negative controls and repeated/zero-x counterexamples. This is a mathematical-model check, not an execution-verified or independently signed claim, library integration test, solver benchmark or general higher-arity validation.
